# Rebecca 1.5.0

Rebecca 1.5.0 adds version-aware Xray configuration support and improves managed outbound recovery, node editing, subscriptions, and external apps.

## Highlights

- 🧩 **Xray 26.9.9 compatibility** — normalize changed outbound, DNS, routing, and UDP-hop settings for newer cores while retaining the format expected by older Xray versions.
- 🔀 **Expanded outbound controls** — configure WireGuard remote DNS, Blackhole custom responses, and local-OS routing rules from the dashboard.
- 🔄 **Managed-service recovery** — reconcile Tor and Windscribe outbounds, reject conflicting instances, and show per-node service health and actionable test errors.
- 🤖 **External apps** — add Faoxima support and improve Mirza webhook setup, rate-limit handling, and backup restoration.
- 🧭 **Node and dashboard reliability** — keep node editing available when a node is unhealthy, refresh virtual-tunnel users promptly, and improve loading and sponsor presentation.

## Reliability and compatibility

- Preserve existing Xray settings in storage and generate configuration appropriate to each node's Xray version.
- Keep legacy V2Ray subscriptions unchanged while normalizing current Xray JSON subscriptions.
- Prevent orphaned usage-history records and prune completed node operations.
- Show backend error details and node service health instead of a generic outbound failure.

## Upgrade notes

> Upgrade Rebecca and Rebecca Node together. Xray 26.9.9-specific settings require a compatible core on the target node; older cores continue to receive their supported configuration. Switching to an older Rebecca build may be incompatible with newer database migrations.
